requirements.title: api-base HTTP Integration
requirements.description: All HTTP REST calls (health, sessions CRUD) route through api-base resolveApiBase/buildApiUrl helpers. No hardcoded origins.

validation.notes: All REST calls use api-base URL builder

requirements.title: api-base WebSocket Integration
requirements.description: WebSocket connections for terminal I/O use api-base WS URL resolution. Connection upgrades work through reverse proxies.

validation.notes: WebSocket URL constructed through api-base resolver

requirements.title: Proxy Connection Upgrade
requirements.description: WebSocket upgrade requests route through reverse proxy without direct-origin assumptions. Connection negotiation handles proxy headers.

validation.notes: WebSocket URL resolution uses api-base WS helpers

requirements.title: Terminal localhost links use the secure loopback proxy
requirements.description: Opening an HTTP localhost or loopback URL detected in terminal output routes it through the Web Console origin, including temporary ports outside scenario metadata. The shared api-base proxy accepts only loopback client connections, dials 127.0.0.1 or ::1 as selected, excludes Web Console listener ports, requires a short-lived capability bound to loopback family and port, preserves path/query behavior, and sandboxes HTML without exposing its token through wildcard CORS.

validation.notes: Loopback URL rewriting preserves the URL while selecting the same-origin IPv4 or IPv6 proxy route.
Covers arbitrary ports, capability and CORS boundaries, HTML/CSS/redirect rewriting, WebSockets, and IPv6 loopback.
